solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Offer money

definitions.meaning: to offer something formally is to put it forward, as with a bid or a resignation
legal currency, as in the phrase legal ___

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a formal bid or proposal, and the currency accepted in payment of a debt.

clue.text: Starts to train regularly enough for squash

indicators.note: the opening letters of the next two words are wanted, as their starts

parts.note: ample means plenty or enough

explanation.surface: Someone trains regularly enough to play the racquet game squash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'squash' looks like the sport but is a verb meaning crush underfoot.
explanation.definitionFit: To crush something underfoot is to flatten or squash it.

clue.text: Latest race appears in this paper

parts.note: the latest thing is the new one
a sprint is a short fast race

explanation.surface: Results of the latest race are printed in this newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Newsprint is the cheap paper newspapers are printed on.

clue.text: Fancy dress?

parts.note: read not as a costume party but as a fancy, high-flown word for the verb dress

explanation.definitionFit: To put a robe on someone is a grand, elaborate way of saying clothe them.

clue.text: Odds and ends a newspaper preserves

parts.note: The Sun is a British tabloid newspaper
dries in the sense of keeping food by removing its moisture

explanation.surface: A newspaper keeps all sorts of odds and ends.
explanation.definitionFit: Sundries are miscellaneous small items, a synonym for odds and ends.

clue.text: One lies parallel to the radius

definitions.text: One lies parallel to the radius

parts.words: One lies parallel to the radius
parts.note: seems to be geometry about a circle's radius, but the radius is the forearm bone and its partner runs alongside it

explanation.definitionFit: The forearm has two long bones side by side, the radius and this one on the little-finger side.

clue.text: Not working, actors get depressed

parts.note: a computer system that is down is not working
the cast is the set of actors in a production

explanation.surface: Out of work, the actors become gloomy.
explanation.definitionFit: Downcast means dejected or low in spirits, a synonym of depressed.

clue.text: Taking forty winks in it would be unsuitable

indicators.note: the nap is placed in it, so its letters sit inside the other word

parts.note: taken as written
forty winks is a short sleep, a nap

explanation.surface: Dozing off in this situation would be inappropriate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking' just sets the scene; 'in' does the work.
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt means not apt, so inappropriate or unsuitable.

clue.text: Report of foolish fraud in Californian valley

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the next words are said aloud

parts.note: foolish is silly and a fraud is a con, giving silly con

explanation.surface: News of a stupid swindle in the tech heartland of California.
explanation.definitionFit: Silicon Valley is the nickname of the tech region south of San Francisco; the clue's valley stands for the full name.

clue.text: Busy couple aboard with Noah, it seems

indicators.note: being aboard means being inside the vessel, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: Noah's vessel was the ark
a couple is two

explanation.surface: The animals went in two by two onto Noah's busy vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at work means being occupied, a synonym of busy.

clue.text: Mushroom that's round and white, naturally

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to grow rapidly
a ball of packed snow is, by nature, round and white

explanation.definitionFit: To grow rapidly like a rolling ball of snow, and that snow ball itself.

clue.text: Keeping watch, crafty dragon grabs you in the end

indicators.note: grabbing takes the other piece inside
crafty means cunningly made, so the letters of dragon are fashioned into a new order
the end of the word you, its final letter

explanation.surface: A cunning dragon pounces on you at last while standing sentry.
explanation.definitionFit: On guard means alert and watchful, keeping watch against danger.

clue.text: Sounds like only non-smokers in the military ensemble

indicators.note: says the next words are heard rather than written

parts.note: if only non-smokers are allowed, the pipe is banned

explanation.surface: A regimental band admits only those who do not smoke.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe band is a band of bagpipers and drummers, often attached to a regiment.

clue.text: Sour puritan shuns society

indicators.note: to shun is to avoid, so the letter is left out

parts.note: an ascetic is a self-denying, puritanical person

explanation.surface: A strait-laced person sourly avoids company.
explanation.definitionFit: Acetic relates to vinegar, so it describes something sour.

clue.text: Mad genius hides ring of fire

indicators.note: hiding something puts it inside, so one piece goes within the other
madness scrambles the word genius into a new order

parts.note: a ring is round, like the letter O

explanation.surface: An insane genius conceals a ring of fire.
explanation.definitionFit: Igneous means formed by heat or relating to fire, as volcanic rock is.

clue.text: Heads of Europe predict increased cutbacks — great!

indicators.note: the heads of the following words are their first letters

explanation.surface: European leaders forecast more spending cuts, to sarcastic cheers.
explanation.definitionFit: Epic is a slang exclamation for something awesome or great.

clue.text: It eggs us on, perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps signals a possible rearrangement of the words before it

explanation.surface: A nudge prods us along.
explanation.definitionFit: A suggestion prompts action, egging people on, and here its letters are the whole clue too.

clue.text: Forgery created by the impressionist

definitions.meaning: a fake copy of something genuine
what a comic impressionist does on stage, mimicking a famous voice

explanation.definitionFit: A fake is a copy, and a mimic's turn is a copy of someone's manner.

clue.text: Therapeutic waterworks?

parts.note: waterworks is slang for tears, and a therapeutic session of them makes you feel better

explanation.definitionFit: A good cry is a long, cathartic bout of weeping that relieves feeling.

clue.text: In one case Roget mixed up his classifications

indicators.note: a mix-up jumbles the letters of the pieces into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
taken as written

explanation.surface: Roget's thesaurus put words into cases, sorting them into groups.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his' points back to Roget, whose thesaurus is arranged by headings.
explanation.definitionFit: Classes or groupings of things are synonymous with classifications.

clue.text: Relatives in America in 1 across, for example

indicators.note: the abbreviation sits in the other word

parts.note: 1 across is money, legal tender; coins are an example
US is the United States

explanation.surface: Relatives in the US are given money.
explanation.definitionFit: Children of one's uncles and aunts are relatives of the first degree of this kind.

clue.text: Police officer or fashion icon

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector in the British police
taken as written

explanation.surface: Is this person a detective or a fashion star?
explanation.definitionFit: Christian Dior was the French couturier behind the New Look, a famous name in fashion.

clue.text: Ruling accepts article will cause some reaction

indicators.note: accepting takes something in, so the article goes inside

parts.note: a regent is ruling in place of a monarch
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A ruling admits an item that will provoke a response.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical substance used to bring about a reaction is the standard sense, so this is a description, not a synonym.

clue.text: One in a hundred may finally be withdrawn

indicators.note: the word one sits in the other piece

parts.note: two Roman fifties, L and L, add up to a hundred

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of may

explanation.surface: One person in a hundred may end up a recluse.
explanation.walkthrough: L is fifty, so LL is the setter's cheeky hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone solitary and isolated feels withdrawn from company.

clue.text: Outcome of overhead kick, you could say

definitions.meaning: a football kick sent upward could jokingly be called a shot up

explanation.definitionFit: The upshot is the eventual result or outcome, and the playful second reading is a shot aimed up.

clue.text: Wonderful lake, retreat of French king — gone!

indicators.note: the letters vanish from the lake's name

parts.note: Lake Superior is the largest of the Great Lakes

indicators.note: a retreat goes backwards, so the word is read from right to left

parts.note: roi is French for king

explanation.surface: A marvellous lake from which the French monarch has fled.
explanation.definitionFit: Super is informal praise meaning excellent or wonderful.

clue.text: Vending machine needs a set of robots

parts.note: an automat is a coin-operated food dispenser

explanation.surface: A vending machine wants a team of robots.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of automaton, a self-operating machine or robot.

clue.text: What Cupid has, say, for a sweetheart

indicators.note: say means spoken, giving a word heard rather than written

parts.note: Cupid carries a bow and arrows

explanation.surface: Cupid's weapon helps him find a lover.
explanation.definitionFit: A beau is a boyfriend or male admirer.

clue.text: Where skilful potter gets ahead financially

definitions.meaning: in snooker or pool, a good potter sends the ball into the hole

explanation.definitionFit: A potted ball lands there, and being in profit is the idiomatic second sense.

clue.text: Directions needed on river to get past it

parts.note: S and E are compass directions south and east
the Nile is the river of Egypt

explanation.surface: Navigating a river with a compass is beyond an old timer.
explanation.definitionFit: Being past it is idiom for too old, and senile describes mental decline in old age.

clue.text: It speedily provides total coverage in colour

definitions.text: It speedily provides total coverage in colour

parts.words: It speedily provides total coverage in colour
parts.note: sounds like a TV news channel's boast, but describes a painting tool

explanation.definitionFit: This compressed-air tool sprays paint quickly and evenly over a surface.

clue.text: A small pen could be crown property

definitions.text: A small pen could be crown property

parts.words: A small pen could be crown property
parts.note: a pen is a female swan, and unmarked swans in Britain belong to the Crown

explanation.definitionFit: A young swan is the youngster of the bird the British monarch traditionally owns.
